legend.en: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.

when.en: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

effect.en: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

legend.en: Long have the Ultramarines guarded both Ultramar and the wider Imperium. No foe can hide from their vengeful gaze or evade the reach of their wrath.

when.en: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot.

effect.en: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].

legend.en: No Chapter’s warriors know better the breadth - theoretical and practical - of the Codex Astartes’ teachings, and how these can and should be adapted to ensure victory.

effect.en: Select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.

legend.en: Roaring their famed battle cry, the Ultramarines hurl themselves into the fight, striving all the harder to prevail beneath the unwavering eye of their Chapter Master.

when.en: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight.

legend.en: After rapidly making a theoretical assessment of the foes’ probable next moves, the Ultramarines apply practical repositioning to counter them.

when.en: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.

effect.en: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

legend.en: With the enemy’s countermeasures and responses predicted and allowed for in advance, the Ultramarines can weather their most ferocious attacks.

when.en: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

effect.en: Attacks that target your unit with a S greater than this unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.
